no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Lifecore Biomedical is a fully integrated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing aseptic formulation and fill-finish services for injectable drug and medical-device products in syringes, vials and cartridges, plus pharmaceutical-grade hyaluronic acid (HA) bulk manufacturing using its proprietary fermentation process. It does not own or develop drug candidates of its own and runs no clinical trials as sponsor. Customers (third-party pharmaceutical/device companies) own the drug development programs Lifecore manufactures. Per workflow rule #10, this is a CDMO/manufacturing-services company with no active P1/P2/P3 internal pipeline.
